description: Pixel Camera 11.1 (v1.1.4-p7p-bento): Experimental Bento HDR+ Highlight Recovery + configurable Max HDR Ratio AE override (Stock/16x/24x/32x), Pixel 7 Pro 50MP lobster flag + Eclipse AE + AV1 hardware guard, bundled 16KB-aligned libpropatcher.so with thread-safe NEON/planar YUV/Tint/grain fixes, opt-in gentle Front Camera Backlight Fix, Portrait Mode ksf.b routing, minSdk 30 + APKM compatibility, and register-range stability fixes.
